coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): The Notion coder solely owns the Reasoning Papers database: search the workspace first and reuse an existing exact-title database, otherwise create it once under a suitable parent page with exactly the properties Title(title), Authors(rich_text), Year(number), Method(select), Key_Contribution(rich_text), Cited_By(number); add exactly five pages (one per frozen paper) with those properties, then retrieve the database and entries to verify.

coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 1): The calendar coder schedules the five reading-group sessions for 2026-03-16 through 2026-03-20, each exactly 10:00-11:00 UTC (start/end dateTime with Z suffix and timeZone UTC), one per paper, with summary exactly 'Reading Group: <topic>' and a description naming the full paper title, first author, year and arXiv ID; search exact summaries first and create only missing events, then get_event every retained ID.
